about.title: About Lubarsch Credit
about.sub: Born in Ibadan. Built for the women who keep our markets running.
story: Every morning, thousands of women open their stalls in Bodija, Oje, Dugbe, Gbagi and Oja'ba. They feed families, pay school fees and keep Ibadan moving.
Too often, when they need money for stock, the only options are slow banks or loan apps that harass them and their contacts.
Lubarsch Credit was started to do it differently: fast working-capital loans, explained clearly, delivered by people you can see and talk to.
about.mission: To give market women and small traders in Ibadan fast, fair and respectful loans that help their businesses grow.

investors.title: Investor notes
investors.sub: Private investment notes that fund working capital for Ibadan's market traders.
investors.whyTitle: Why we lend to market women
why: Market traders run high-turnover businesses with daily cash flow, which suits short, frequent repayment cycles.
Most have limited access to formal credit, so a well-run, respectful lender fills a real gap.
Close relationships — officer visits, guarantors and market associations — support disciplined repayment.
investors.baselineNote: Baseline return is a target, not a guarantee. Final terms are set out in the note agreement.
use: Funds are lent as short-term working-capital loans to vetted traders in Ibadan.
Loans are disbursed to borrowers' bank accounts, never in cash.
Operating costs and reserves are disclosed in our investor pack.
risk: Every borrower is visited at their place of business by a Lubarsch officer.
Every loan has a guarantor; identities are checked against BVN/NIN.
Daily and weekly collections give early warning of difficulty.
Limits start small and grow with a good repayment record.

faqs.title: Questions and answers
faqs.sub: Can't find your answer? Call or WhatsApp us — we are happy to explain.
faqs.noResults: No questions match. Try another word, or ask us directly.

items.a: Traders and small business owners in Ibadan who are 18 or older, have a shop, stall or regular trading spot, a valid ID, a BVN, and a guarantor who knows them.
It depends on the loan and your business. First loans start smaller. When you repay well, you can borrow more next time. Use our calculator to see the current range.

items.q: How fast will I get the money?
items.a: An officer will call you within 24 hours (working days). After the shop visit and approval, the money is sent to your bank account — often within a few days of applying.
Yes. Your guarantor should be someone who knows you well, such as your husband or wife, a family member, a fellow trader or your market association leader. Our officer will speak with them.

items.q: Can I get another loan after I finish paying?
items.a: Yes. Customers who repay well can apply again, often for a bigger amount.
There is a flat ₦2,000 admin fee on every loan, taken when you receive the money, plus interest. The calculator and your offer show every naira before you agree. There are no hidden charges.

items.q: Why is interest taken upfront on daily loans?
items.a: On the daily loan, we take the interest when you receive the money. This keeps your daily payments small and simple, because they only cover what you borrowed. For example, borrow ₦50,000 for 20 days: you receive ₦42,000 and pay ₦2,500 a day.
Daily loans are paid every market day. Weekly loans are paid once a week. Your officer will agree the day and time with you.

items.q: Can I pay through bank transfer, POS or an officer?
items.a: Yes. You can pay by bank transfer to our company account, at our office, or to an identified Lubarsch officer who will always give you a receipt. Never pay into a personal account.

items.q: What happens if I miss a payment?
items.a: Call or WhatsApp your officer as soon as you can. We will talk with you and agree a plan. We never shame customers in the market.

items.q: Will you call my family or contacts?
items.a: No. We never access or message your phone contacts. We only speak with you and the guarantor you chose, and we never share your loan with anyone else.
Yes. Your BVN is stored encrypted and only used to confirm your identity. A BVN cannot be used to take money from your account. We will never ask for your PIN, OTP or bank password.

items.q: Are investor notes the same as a savings account?
items.a: No. Lubarsch Credit does not take deposits or offer savings accounts. Investor notes are private investments with risk — please read the Investors page.
